header.name: ORIGIN: Build Your Own Hero §8(RP)
header.description: v0.23 - Mjolnir (lift it from the stone in Asgard if you're worthy: throw it, call it back, fly, summon lightning), the Vanguard Shield, Shock Batons and Agent Gauntlets, three new suits (Vanguard, Infiltrator, Thunder God), a stronger Lumen Signet (8 colours, Hand, Spear, Gatling, Titan, overcharge), and XoX reborn: a new design and a three-phase fight. Build Your Own Hero.
